primary_task: Investigate a problematic superpowers agent session by reading its transcripts on disk, dispatching analyst subagents, and writing an evidence-cited report (optionally GitHub issue / scrubbed bundle).

requirements.name: Bash
requirements.evidence: Resolve each session to verified absolute filesystem paths; Create `~/.superpowers/diagnosing-superpowers/<session-id>/`

requirements.name: Agent
requirements.evidence: dispatch one analyst subagent per dimension in parallel

requirements.name: Write
requirements.evidence: Fill every section of `templates/report.md` in order, write it to the workspace

requirements.name: gh
requirements.evidence: GitHub issues — when report §7 says possible or likely, or your partner asks ... `gh` cannot attach files

notes: Session transcripts exist under /root/.claude/projects. GitHub-issue and export steps are conditional. gh in this session cannot use GraphQL (issue search/create may need REST or github MCP).
